alerts.header: Shuttle Busing Between Norristown Transit Center and Bridgeport Station
alerts.description: Bus service replaces train service from Norristown Transit Center to Bridgeport Station through December 19. Passengers should allow an additional 15 minutes for travel. For details and schedules, visit SEPTA.org. Shuttle bus information is available on a separate Shuttle Bus schedule page.
11th St and the 11th St concourse is closed to fast-track elevator construction and renovations. Please use 13th St during construction. For more information, visit SEPTA.org.
The eastbound stop at Washington Ave & Moyamensing Ave is closed. Use nearby stop at Washington Ave & 3rd St.
Stops at Front & Ellsworth, Washington & 4th and Moyamensing & 2nd are closed. Use nearby stops at Washington Ave & Front, 3rd or 5th.

alerts.header: Shuttle Busing Between 33rd Street Station to the Malvern Loop
alerts.description: Bus service replaces trolley service from 33rd Street Station to the Malvern Loop, on Saturday, November 7 and Sunday, November 8.

alerts.header: Monthly Saturday Shuttle Busing 69th St Transit Center to Media/Sharon Hill
alerts.description: To conduct overhead wire inspections and maintenance, shuttle buses replace trolley service on the first Saturday of each month until further notice. Riders should allow an additional 15 minutes for travel. For details and schedules, visit  SEPTA.org. Shuttle bus information is available on a separate  D1 bus &  D2 bus schedule pages.

alerts.header: Eastbound Platform Boarding Allegheny to Berks Stations
alerts.description: From 6 pm on Saturday, November 7, until the end of service, passengers must board on the eastbound platforms from Allegheny to Berks stations.

alerts.header: Weekly Sunday & Monday Trolley Tunnel Diversion
alerts.description: Service is re-routed to 40th St and Market St on Sunday and Monday nights beginning at 10 pm until 5 am the next morning due to scheduled maintenance. Use the [L] Market-Frankford Line for continued service to/from Center City.

alerts.header: Media-Sharon Hill Line is Now the “D”
alerts.description: The Media-Sharon Hill Line is now the “D” as part of system-wide wayfinding improvements. The 101 is the D1, and the 102 is the D2. Expect to see both old and new language used through the transition. Learn more at septa.org/metro.

alerts.header: Norristown High Speed Line is Now the “M”
alerts.description: The Norristown High Speed Line is now the “M” as part of system-wide wayfinding improvements. Expect to see both old and new language used through the transition. Learn more at septa.org/metro.

alerts.header: 8th-Market Station Elevator to Eastbound Platform Out of Service
alerts.description: The elevator at 8th-Market Station to the eastbound platform is out of service until mid-December. For accessible eastbound travel, please use 5th St/Independence Hall Station.

alerts.header: Southbound Platform Boarding Snyder and Oregon Stations
alerts.description: From Monday, November 2 through Friday, November 6, from 10 pm until the end of service daily, passengers must board on the southbound platforms at Snyder and Oregon stations.

alerts.header: Westbound Platform Boarding Baltimore Ave to Drexel Hill Junction Stations
alerts.description: From Monday, November 2 through Friday, November 6, from 9:30 am to 3 pm daily, passengers must board on the westbound platforms from Baltimore Ave to Drexel Hill Junction stations.

alerts.header: Southbound Platform Boarding Snyder and Oregon Stations
alerts.description: From Monday, November 9 through Friday, November 13, from 10 pm until the end of service daily, passengers must board on the southbound platforms at Snyder and Oregon stations.

alerts.header: Potential Delays due to Amtrak Infrastructure Project
alerts.description: Due to an Amtrak infrastructure project near William H. Gray III 30th St Station: Paoli/Thorndale, Cynwyd, Trenton, Chestnut Hill West, Fox Chase and West Trenton trains may experience delays of up to 10 minutes through early November. Please plan for added travel time. SEPTA apologizes for the inconvenience.

alerts.header: Shuttle Busing Conshohocken to Norristown - Elm St Stations
alerts.description: Bus service replaces trains from Conshohocken to Norristown - Elm St stations on November 7-8 and November 14-15. Riders should allow an additional 10-15 minutes for travel. For details and schedules, visit septa.org. Shuttle bus information is available on a separate  Manayunk/Norristown Shuttle Bus schedule page.

alerts.header: Marcus Hook, Glenolden, Norwood Stations Discontinue Fare Product Sales
alerts.description: Due to a wide array of alternate purchase options, sales at Marcus Hook, Glenolden and Norwood stations are discontinued, effective close of business November 20. Registered SEPTA Key Card holders (includes SEPTA Key Senior Fare, SEPTA Key Reduced Fare and CCT holders) continue to have access to the waiting areas of the stations. During designated times, waiting areas are open for seating, restrooms and other amenities.

alerts.header: West Trenton Station Waiting Room Closed
alerts.description: Due to vandalism, the waiting room at West Trenton Station is closed until further notice. Report problems using the SEPTA App (available for iOS and Android); the “Help” tab lets you discreetly report incidents or suspicious activity in seconds.

alerts.header: No Parking in North Lot at Chestnut Hill East Station
alerts.description: The North Lot at Chestnut Hill East Station is closed for stormwater and restoration work until further notice.

alerts.header: Outbound Platform Boarding from Noble to Neshaminy Falls Stations
alerts.description: On weekdays from Monday, November 2 through Friday, November 20, from 9:30 am to 2 pm daily, passengers must board on the outbound platforms from Noble to Neshaminy Falls stations.
On weekdays from Monday, November 2 through Friday, November 20, from 9:30 am to 2 pm daily, passengers must board on the outbound platform at Jenkintown-Wyncote Station.

alerts.header: Inbound Platform Boarding from Noble to Neshaminy Falls Stations
